summary: Outlook Therapeutics, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of common stock and warrants, a routine capital raise rather than a special situation. Terms are incomplete; the offering pairs one warrant per share, exercisable at a blank price for five years, with shares traded on Nasdaq and last priced at $1.13. The registrant is the issuer, not a party to a transformative corporate event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation category applies, so the filing is classified as None with high confidence.
